description: A script for controlling access to branches and tags in a Git repository, implementing policies such as fast-forward only updates, user and group-based permissions, and preventing overwriting tags.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Outputs 'grant' and exits with success status, granting access.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Outputs 'deny' and exits with failure status, denying access.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages if verbose mode is enabled.
